name: Make
summary: Visual no-code platform for building automations and AI agent workflows across apps.
description: Make is a no-code automation platform where users build workflows, called scenarios, on a visual canvas that connects thousands of apps. It also supports AI agents that run inside those workflows. Usage is measured in credits. A free plan includes 1,000 credits per month, and paid plans add more credits and features; enterprise plans include 24/7 support.
